content: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server is announcing the general availability of Cobalt 200 ARM-based compute. Cobalt 200 expands the Flexible Server compute portfolio with Microsoft-designed ARM64-based compute, giving you an additional architecture choice alongside Intel and AMD x64-based compute. With Cobalt 200, you can choose the compute architecture that best fits your PostgreSQL workload, compatibility, and infrastructure requirements. Learn more.
